GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Which Indian tea variety was the first product to receive a Geographical Indication (GI) tag in India in 2004-05?
GI Tags in India.fact: Darjeeling tea was the first Indian product to receive a GI tag in 2004-05. It is grown in the Darjeeling district of West Bengal and is known worldwide for its distinctive aroma and flavour.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Which aromatic rice variety from the Indo-Gangetic plains received a GI tag?
GI Tags in India.fact: Basmati rice, known for its long grains and aromatic fragrance, received a GI tag. It is primarily grown in the Indo-Gangetic plains of India and Pakistan.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: The famous Alphonso mango variety is GI-tagged from which Indian state?
GI Tags in India.fact: The Alphonso mango (Hapus) from the Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, and other coastal districts of Maharashtra received a GI tag. It is known for its rich taste and vibrant saffron color.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Banarasi sarees, known for their intricate weaving, are GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Banarasi sarees from Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, received a GI tag. These sarees are renowned for their fine silk and intricate gold and silver brocade work (zari).

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Kanchipuram silk sarees, known for their durability and lustre, are GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Kanchipuram silk sarees from Tamil Nadu received a GI tag. These sarees are known for their heavy silk, contrasting borders, and intricate zari work.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Mysore silk, known for its pure silk and gold zari, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Mysore silk from Karnataka received a GI tag. The Mysore Silk Weaving Factory, established in 1912, produces this high-quality silk fabric.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Chanderi fabric, known for its lightweight and sheer texture, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Chanderi fabric from the Chanderi town in Madhya Pradesh received a GI tag. It is known for its fine cotton and silk blends with gold and silver motifs.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Pashmina shawls, made from the fine wool of Changthangi goats, are GI-tagged from which region?
GI Tags in India.fact: Kashmir Pashmina received a GI tag. The wool is sourced from Changthangi goats in the Ladakh region and hand-spun and woven in Kashmir.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Nilgiri tea, known for its brisk and fragrant brew, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Nilgiri tea from the Nilgiri Hills of Tamil Nadu received a GI tag. It is known for its smooth flavour, bright colour, and floral aroma.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: In which year was the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act enacted in India?
GI Tags in India.fact: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act was enacted in 1999 and came into force in 2003. It is administered by the Geographical Indications Registry headquartered in Chennai.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Which city hosts the Geographical Indications Registry of India?
GI Tags in India.fact: The Geographical Indications Registry is headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. It operates under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Naga Mircha (Naga King Chilli) is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Naga Mircha (Naga King Chilli) from Nagaland received a GI tag. It is one of the world's hottest chillies, with a Scoville heat unit rating of over 1,000,000.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Phulkari embroidery, a traditional folk art, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Phulkari embroidery from Punjab received a GI tag. Phulkari, meaning 'flower work', is a traditional embroidery style featuring colourful thread work on shawls and dupattas.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Madhubani paintings, a traditional Mithila art form, are GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Madhubani paintings from Bihar received a GI tag. This ancient art form uses natural dyes and pigments and features intricate geometric patterns and mythological themes.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Chikankari embroidery, a traditional Lucknowi craft, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Chikankari embroidery from Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, received a GI tag. It is a delicate and intricate embroidery style done with white thread on fine cotton or muslin fabric.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Kalamkari painting, a traditional hand-painted cotton textile, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Kalamkari painting from Andhra Pradesh received a GI tag. It involves hand-painting or block-printing on cotton fabric using natural dyes.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Thanjavur painting, a classical South Indian art form, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Thanjavur painting from Tamil Nadu received a GI tag. These paintings are known for their rich colours, gold foil work, and depiction of Hindu gods and goddesses.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: The famous Rasgulla, a syrupy dessert, was awarded a GI tag to which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Odisha received a GI tag for 'Odisha Rasagola' in 2018. The origin of rasgulla is disputed between Odisha and West Bengal, with West Bengal also receiving a GI tag for 'Banglar Rosogolla' in 2017.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Kashmiri saffron, known for its high-quality crocin content, is GI-tagged from which union territory?
GI Tags in India.fact: Kashmiri saffron (Pampore saffron) from Jammu and Kashmir received a GI tag. It is one of the finest saffrons in the world, cultivated in the Pampore region.

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: The Geographical Indications Act is administered by which ministry of the Government of India?
GI Tags in India.fact: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 is administered by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, through the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).

GI Tags in India.subject: Current Affairs
GI Tags in India.question: Tulaipanji rice, an aromatic fine-grained rice variety, is GI-tagged from which state?
GI Tags in India.fact: Tulaipanji rice from West Bengal received a GI tag. It is a traditional aromatic rice variety grown in the North Dinajpur and South Dinajpur districts.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of India?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Sucheta Kripalani was the first woman Chief Minister of India, serving as the CM of Uttar Pradesh from 1963 to 1967. She was also a freedom fighter and a member of the Constituent Assembly.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Sucheta Kripalani became the first woman CM of which Indian state in 1963?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Sucheta Kripalani served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh from 1963 to 1967. She was the first woman to hold the office of Chief Minister in any Indian state.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Nandini Satpathy was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Nandini Satpathy served as the Chief Minister of Odisha from 1972 to 1976. She was the first woman CM of Odisha and the second woman CM in India after Sucheta Kripalani.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Shashikala Kakodkar was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Shashikala Kakodkar served as the Chief Minister of Goa, Daman and Diu from 1973 to 1979. She was the first woman CM of Goa and served for the longest continuous tenure among the early women CMs.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Syeda Anwara Taimur was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Syeda Anwara Taimur served as the Chief Minister of Assam from 1980 to 1981. She was the first woman CM of Assam and the first Muslim woman CM of any Indian state.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Janaki Ramachandran was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Janaki Ramachandran served as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu for 24 days in 1988. She was the first woman CM of Tamil Nadu, following the death of her husband M. G. Ramachandran.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of Bihar?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Rabri Devi served as the Chief Minister of Bihar from 1997 to 1999 and later for two more terms. She was the first woman CM of Bihar and succeeded her husband Lalu Prasad Yadav.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Sheila Dikshit was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state/UT?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Sheila Dikshit served as the Chief Minister of Delhi from 1998 to 2013. She was the first woman CM of Delhi and served for three consecutive terms, making her the longest-serving CM of Delhi.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Vasundhara Raje was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Vasundhara Raje served as the Chief Minister of Rajasthan from 2003 to 2008 and again from 2013 to 2018. She was the first woman CM of Rajasthan.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Mamata Banerjee was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Mamata Banerjee became the first woman Chief Minister of West Bengal in 2011. She founded the All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) in 1998 and is currently serving as the CM of West Bengal.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Jayalalithaa was the first woman Chief Minister of which state to complete a full term?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Jayalalithaa served as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu for multiple terms (1991-1996, 2002-2006, 2011-2014, 2015-2016). She was the first woman CM of Tamil Nadu to complete a full five-year term.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Mehbooba Mufti was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state/UT?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Mehbooba Mufti served as the Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir from 2016 to 2018. She was the first woman CM of the state and the daughter of former CM Mufti Mohammad Sayeed.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Anandiben Patel was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Anandiben Patel served as the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2014 to 2016. She was the first woman CM of Gujarat and later became the Governor of Uttar Pradesh.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of Punjab?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Rajinder Kaur Bhattal served as the Chief Minister of Punjab from 1996 to 1997. She was the first woman CM of Punjab and later served as Deputy Chief Minister.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Uma Bharti was the first woman Chief Minister of which Indian state?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Uma Bharti served as the Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh for a brief period in 2003-2004. She was the first woman CM of Madhya Pradesh.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: In which year did Sucheta Kripalani become the first woman Chief Minister of India?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Sucheta Kripalani became the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh on 2 October 1963, making her the first woman CM in India.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Nandini Satpathy served as the first woman CM of Odisha under which political party?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Nandini Satpathy was a member of the Indian National Congress and served as the Chief Minister of Odisha from 1972 to 1976.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Which freedom fighter and member of the Constituent Assembly became the first woman Chief Minister of India?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Sucheta Kripalani was a freedom fighter, member of the Constituent Assembly, and later became the first woman Chief Minister of India (Uttar Pradesh, 1963-1967).

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Which state had the first woman Chief Minister in India?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Uttar Pradesh had the first woman CM in India when Sucheta Kripalani took office in 1963.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Who is the current longest-serving woman Chief Minister in India?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Mamata Banerjee has been the Chief Minister of West Bengal since 20 May 2011, making her the longest-serving woman CM in India.

First Woman Chief Minister.subject: Current Affairs
First Woman Chief Minister.question: Anandiben Patel became the first woman Chief Minister of Gujarat in which year?
First Woman Chief Minister.fact: Anandiben Patel became the first woman Chief Minister of Gujarat on 22 May 2014, succeeding Narendra Modi after he became Prime Minister.
